1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.CutRayCoordinates
2 
3 /-! The interiors swept out by continuously varying shortest routes.
4 These are actual surface regions, parametrized by a target and a time
5 strictly between the source and the cut endpoint. -/
6 
7 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
8 
9 open Set BoundedContinuousFunction
10 
11 /-- Regard a time strictly between zero and one as a closed-unit-interval time. -/
12 def interiorTime (t : Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) : unitInterval := ⟨t.val, t.property.1.le, t.property.2.le⟩
13 
14 theorem interiorTime_continuous : Continuous interiorTime := continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _
15 
16 /-- Evaluate a continuous route family at an interior time. -/
17 noncomputable def routeStripMap {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
18     (routes : C(X, P.BoundaryCurve)) : C(X × Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, frontier P.body) :=
19   ⟨fun p => routes p.1 (interiorTime p.2), continuous_eval.comp
20     ((routes.continuous.comp continuous_fst).prodMk (interiorTime_continuous.comp continuous_snd))⟩
21 
22 /-- The actual points swept out before reaching the terminal cut targets. -/
23 def routeStrip {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
24     (routes : C(X, P.BoundaryCurve)) : Set (frontier P.body) := range (routeStripMap routes)
25 
26 namespace SixVertexGraph
27 
28 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
29   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
30     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
31 
32 include graph small_faces in
33 /-- A strip parametrized by distinct cut endpoints has no self-identifications. -/
34 theorem routeStripMap_injective (a : frontier P.body) {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
35     (target : X → frontier P.body) (injective_target : Function.Injective target)
36     (cut : ∀ x, target x ∈ P.cutSet a) (routes : C(X, P.BoundaryCurve))
37     (member : ∀ x, routes x ∈ P.geodesicFiber a (target x)) :
38     Function.Injective (routeStripMap routes) := by
39   rintro ⟨x, s⟩ ⟨y, t⟩ meet
40   have same := graph.cut_rays_meeting small_faces a (target x) (target y) (cut x) (cut y)
41     (routes x) (routes y) (member x) (member y) (interiorTime s) (interiorTime t)
42     s.property.1 s.property.2 meet
43   have times : s.val = t.val := congrArg (fun r : unitInterval => (r : ℝ)) same.2.1
44   exact Prod.ext (injective_target same.1) (Subtype.ext times)
45 
46 include graph small_faces in
47 /-- Two distinct route branches over the same cut-edge targets sweep disjoint interiors. -/
48 theorem routeStrips_disjoint (a : frontier P.body) {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
49     (target : X → frontier P.body) (injective_target : Function.Injective target)
50     (cut : ∀ x, target x ∈ P.cutSet a) (first second : C(X, P.BoundaryCurve))
51     (first_member : ∀ x, first x ∈ P.geodesicFiber a (target x))
52     (second_member : ∀ x, second x ∈ P.geodesicFiber a (target x))
53     (distinct : ∀ x, first x ≠ second x) : Disjoint (routeStrip first) (routeStrip second) := by
54   apply disjoint_left.mpr
55   rintro b ⟨⟨x, s⟩, hx⟩ ⟨⟨y, t⟩, hy⟩
56   have same := graph.cut_rays_meeting small_faces a (target x) (target y) (cut x) (cut y)
57     (first x) (second y) (first_member x) (second_member y) (interiorTime s) (interiorTime t)
58     s.property.1 s.property.2 (hx.trans hy.symm)
59   have parameters := injective_target same.1
60   exact distinct x (same.2.2.trans (congrArg second parameters.symm))
61 
62 include graph small_faces in
63 /-- Every point in a route strip avoids both the source and the cut set. -/
64 theorem routeStrip_outside_cutSet (a : frontier P.body) {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
65     (target : X → frontier P.body) (cut : ∀ x, target x ∈ P.cutSet a)
66     (routes : C(X, P.BoundaryCurve)) (member : ∀ x, routes x ∈ P.geodesicFiber a (target x))
67     (b : frontier P.body) (inside : b ∈ routeStrip routes) : b ≠ a ∧ b ∉ P.cutSet a := by
68   obtain ⟨⟨x, t⟩, rfl⟩ := inside
69   have h := member x
70   have first : routes x 0 = a := congrArg Prod.fst h.2
71   have last : routes x 1 = target x := congrArg Prod.snd h.2
72   have different : a ≠ target x := fun same => P.source_not_cutSet a (same.symm ▸ cut x)
73   constructor
74   · intro same
75     have equal := P.geodesicFiber_injective a (target x) different (routes x) h (same.trans first.symm)
76     have real_equal := congrArg Subtype.val equal
77     exact t.property.1.ne' real_equal
78   · have outside := graph.geodesic_proper_prefix_outside_cutSet small_faces (routes x) h.1
79       (by simpa only [first, last] using different) (interiorTime t) t.property.2
80     simpa only [first] using outside
81
